limitations: Analyst-authored harder requirements do not establish empirical model difficulty.
These two development tasks share the same component and ancestry; they are not independent held-out repository families.
The two tasks are independent extensions of a frozen model-grown seed, not stages of a new sequential run.
Finite Python oracles check intended examples, not Dafny parsing, proof correctness or runtime verification.
Earlier broad AWS/MPL qualification remains failed and unchanged.

native_qualification.gates: Controls remain unsubmitted until both source-bound references pass; preserve all unexpected failures before a deliberate revision.
native_qualification.new_actual_unit_labels: UNKNOWN until native qualification; do not invent correctness labels for function methods.
native_qualification.omission_policy: Staged bad target file omitted from every explicit root and include path; native pass of the five-file base must not count as requested six-file success.
native_qualification.required_review: Every frozen old native unit, actual new emitted declarations and target, exact source/tool/raw hashes; missing or unexpected coverage is separate from proof status.
native_qualification.unproved_helper_policy: Mutate only an accepted helper body while preserving its contract in an analyst-only negative; require genuine helper proof failure and record actual new-client and other-provider outcomes. A passing client cannot mask a failed helper.

protected_edits.editable_region: exactly one function expression body in one new file
fixed: all five saved model-grown base files
all declarations, types, imports, specifications, signatures and decreases
protected_edits.reuse_measure: syntactic call/reveal observations only; no necessary-dependency or minimality claim

seed.scope: qualified UInt three-file component plus the actual accepted ReadU16Frame and ReadFramePair additions
seed.selection_rule: earliest complete accepted AWS lineage by the frozen prior execution order

contracts: input equals canonical encoding of returned payloads concatenated with returned suffix
suffix is exactly the input slice after that encoded prefix
aws-batch.fairness_note: The fixed helpers define feasibility and encoding, but no completed decoder or analyst reference body is shown by the task template.
fixed_specs: BoundedPayloads: all payload lengths fit uint16
EncodeFrames: canonical recursive serialization, not a decoder
aws-batch.meaning: Decode exactly count consecutive uint16-length-prefixed byte strings; return their original order and the exact remaining suffix.
new_reasoning: arbitrary-count recursion with fixed decreases count
recursive result aggregation in original order
composing canonical encodings and exact suffix
aws-batch.success_iff: The input has at least count complete frames; count is nat, and count=0 succeeds with zero payloads and unchanged input even when input is malformed.

budget_includes: first payload after removing its one-byte tag
contracts: success iff all syntactic and semantic conditions hold
exact untagged first payload, second payload and suffix
uint16 length bounds for re-tagged first and second fields
original input re-encoding identity with the tag restored
fixed_specs: IsTaggedBounded: declarative conjunction of parsing, tag and budget conditions
aws-tagged.meaning: Parse the frozen frame pair, validate and remove a leading tag byte in the first payload, enforce a combined payload budget, and preserve the second payload and suffix exactly.
aws-tagged.success_iff: Exactly: two complete frames are available, the first payload is nonempty and starts with the requested byte tag, and untagged-first length plus second length is at most budget.
